title: AutoCorrect
description: ZDev's AutoCorrect is a plugin for Minecraft servers on Paper 1.20.1 that automatically replaces words in a chat.
body:
AutoCorrect is a powerful chat enhancement plugin that brings professional text correction to your Minecraft server. Tired of seeing "pc", "tg", or other abbreviations in your chat? This plugin automatically transforms them into proper, full words, making your server's communication more professional and easier to read.

**What does it do?**
• Automatically replaces common abbreviations with their full forms (e.g., "pc" → "computer", "tg" → "Telegram")
• Filters and censors inappropriate content in real-time
• Standardizes technical terminology across your server
• Sends welcome messages to new players
• Works seamlessly with Paper 1.20.1+
**
Why should you use it?**
• Maintains a professional chat environment
• Reduces confusion from abbreviations and slang
• Protects your community from inappropriate content
• Easy to configure - just edit the YAML file
• Lightweight and efficient - no impact on server performance

**Perfect for:**
• Professional Minecraft servers
• Educational institutions
• Community servers
• Any server wanting to maintain high chat standards
